# ar/ (Accounts Receivable — PRD-06)

## Endpoints

### Disputes
- `GET /api/accounting/ar/disputes` — list
- `POST /api/accounting/ar/disputes` — open dispute
- `GET /api/accounting/ar/disputes/[id]` — detail
- `POST /api/accounting/ar/disputes/[id]/resolve` — resolve with outcome
- `POST /api/accounting/ar/disputes/[id]/withdraw` — close without resolution

### Dunning (reminders engine)
- `GET|PUT /api/accounting/ar/dunning/settings` — per-company auto-send opt-in + min-outstanding floor
- `GET /api/accounting/ar/dunning/sends` — history (`?invoiceId=&responseAction=&limit=`)
- `POST /api/accounting/ar/dunning/send` — manual send
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/ar/dunning/templates` — list/create
- `PUT /api/accounting/ar/dunning/templates/[id]` — update
- `POST /api/accounting/ar/dunning/templates/[id]/preview` — render with sample data
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/ar/dunning/overrides` — per-customer ladder overrides
- `GET|DELETE /api/accounting/ar/dunning/overrides/[customerId]` — customer-specific override

### Invoice (extensions on existing customer-invoices)
- `POST /api/accounting/ar/invoice/[id]/pdf` — (re)generate PDF
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/ar/invoice/[id]/portal-link` — get/create portal signed link
- `GET /api/accounting/ar/invoice/[id]/views` — portal view audit trail

### Receipt match (PRD-06 Phase 4)
- `GET /api/accounting/ar/receipt-match/[bankTxId]` — candidate invoice matches
- `POST /api/accounting/ar/receipt-match/confirm` — confirm allocation

### Sent mirror (IMAP/Gmail/M365 scan of sent folder — PRD-06 Phase 6)
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/ar/sent-mirror/connections` — list/create connection
- `PATCH|DELETE /api/accounting/ar/sent-mirror/connections/[id]` — update/remove
- `GET /api/accounting/ar/sent-mirror/connections/[id]/log` — scan history
- `POST /api/accounting/ar/sent-mirror/connections/[id]/scan-now` — trigger scan

## Auth
`withAuth(withErrorHandler(withWriteAccess(handler)))` on mutating routes; read-only routes drop `withWriteAccess`.

## Business rules
- Dunning settings default opt-out — row absent means auto-send disabled
- `min_outstanding_zar` must be ≥ 0
- Response-action filter on sends: `paid|promised|disputed|silent|none`
- Sent-mirror seals evidence against dunning sends (Phase 6)
- Receipt-match confirm posts allocation; rate limit handled via service layer
